$schema-comment: Canonical behavior contract for FunnelOrchestrator on both platforms. Each scenario asserts the full forward step sequence given a starting set of answers and an optional register event. Loaded by iOS FunnelOrchestratorTests.swift and Android FunnelOrchestratorTest.kt; both must produce expectedSequence verbatim. Since 2026-11-25 memoryForgetfulness goes to levelPreview (the training preference, whose choice is functionality_level) whatever the answers; chairRise / challengeArea / standingComfort stay in the contract, unreached, so a stored chair answer changes nothing. painStats ('אתה לא לבד') was removed from the flow; body-areas now goes straight to plan-building regardless of pain_areas. See ADR-0001.

scenarios.name: independent_branch_with_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Chair-rise alone/with_support no longer branches (levelPreview after memory); body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed); phone OTP.

scenarios.name: independent_branch_no_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Chair-rise with_support no longer branches (levelPreview after memory); body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed).

scenarios.name: assisted_branch_with_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Chair-rise with_handles no longer branches (levelPreview after memory); body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed); phone OTP.

scenarios.name: assisted_branch_apple
scenarios.description: with_handles -> standingComfort; Apple Sign-In bypasses OTP (register -> payment).

scenarios.name: independent_null_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Null pain_areas: body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed). Pins Swift(nil)/Kotlin(null) parity.
